verses.en: The word of YAHUAH that came unto Hoshea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Yehudah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Yisra'el.
verses.am: በይሁዳ ነገሥታት በዖዝያንና በኢዮአታም በአካዝና በሕዝቅያስም ዘመን በእስራኤልም ንጉሥ በዮአስ ልጅ በኢዮርብዓም ዘመን ወደ ብኤሪ ልጅ ወደ ሆሴዕ የመጣ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ይህ ነው።

verses.en: The beginning of the word of YAHUAH by Hoshea. And YAHUAH said to Hoshea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms and children of whoredoms: for the land hath committed great whoredom, departing from YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር መጀመሪያ በሆሴዕ በተናገረ ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔር ሆሴዕን። ምድሪቱ ከእግዚአብሔር ርቃ ታላቅ ግልሙትና ታደርጋለችና ሂድ፤ ጋለሞታን ሴትና የግልሙትናን ልጆች ለአንተ ውሰድ አለው።

verses.en: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; which conceived, and bare him a son.
verses.am: እርሱም ሄዶ የዴቤላይምን ልጅ ጎሜርን አገባ፤ እርስዋም ፀነሰች ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደችለት።

verses.en: And YAHUAH said unto him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Yisra'el.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ከጥቂት ዘመን በኋላ የኢይዝራኤልን ደም በኢዩ ቤት ላይ እበቀላለሁና፥ ከእስራኤልም ቤት መንግሥትን እሽራለሁና ስሙን ኢይዝራኤል ብለህ ጥራው፤

verses.en: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Yisra'el in the valley of Jezreel.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን በኢይዝራኤል ሸለቆ ውስጥ የእስራኤልን ቀስት እሰብራለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And she conceived again, and bare a daughter. And YAHUAH said unto him, Call her name Loruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Yisra'el; but I will utterly take them away.
verses.am: ደግሞ ፀነሰች ሴት ልጅንም ወለደች። እግዚአብሔርም። ይቅር እላቸው ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ቤት ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አልምርምና ስምዋን ሎሩሃማ ብለህ ጥራት፤

verses.en: But I will have mercy upon the house of Yehudah, and will save them by YAHUAH their YAHUAH, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የይሁዳን ቤት እምራለሁ፤ በአምላካቸውም በእግዚአብሔር አድናቸዋለሁ እንጂ በቀስት ወይም በሰይፍ ወይም በሰልፍ ወይም በፈረሶች ወይም በፈረሰኞች አላድናቸውም አለው።

verses.en: Now when she had weaned Loruhamah, she conceived, and bare a son.
verses.am: ሎሩሃማም ጡት ባስጣለች ጊዜ፥ ደግሞ ፀነሰች ወንድ ልጅንም ወለደች።

verses.en: Then said YAHUAH, Call his name Loammi: for ye are not my people, and I will not be your YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። ሕዝቤ አይደላችሁምና፥ እኔም አምላክ አልሆናችሁምና ስሙን ሎዓሚ ብለህ ጥራው አለው።

verses.en: Yet the number of the children of Yisra'el shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living YAHUAH.
Then shall the children of Yehudah and the children of Yisra'el be gathered together, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up out of the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.
Say ye unto your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ruhamah.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ቍጥር እንደማይሰፈርና እንደማይቈጠር እንደ ባሕር አሸዋ ይሆናል፤ እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እናንተ ሕዝቤ አይደላችሁም ተብሎ በተነገረበት በዚያ ስፍራ የሕያው አምላክ ልጆች ይባላሉ።

verses.en: Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her whoredoms out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
verses.am: የይሁዳ ልጆችና የእስራኤል ልጆች በአንድነት ይሰበሰባሉ፥ ለእነርሱም አንድ አለቃ ይሾማሉ፥ ከምድሪቱም ይወጣሉ፤ የኢይዝራኤል ቀን ታላቅ ይሆናልና።

verses.en: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and slay her with thirst.
verses.am: ወንድሞቻችሁን። ዓሚ፥ እኅቶቻችሁንም። ሩሃማ በሉአቸው።

verses.en: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they be the children of whoredoms.
verses.am: እናታችሁ ሚስቴ አይደለችምና፥ እኔም ባልዋ አይደለሁምና ተምዋገቱ፤ ከእናታችሁ ጋር ተምዋገቱ። ግልሙትናዋን ከፊትዋ፥ ምንዝርናዋንም ከጡቶችዋ መካከል ታስወግድ፤

verses.en: For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.
verses.am: ዕራቁትዋን እንዳልገፍፋት፥ እንደ ተወለደችበትም ቀን እንዳላደርጋት፥ እንደ ምድረ በዳና እንደ ደረቅ ምድር እንዳላደርጋት፥ በጥማትም እንዳልገድላት፤

verses.en: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
verses.am: የግልሙትናዋ ልጆች ናቸውና ልጆችዋን አልምርም።

verses.en: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.
verses.am: እናታቸው አመንዝራለች፤ የፀነሰቻቸውም። እንጀራዬንና ውኃዬን፥ ጥጤንና የተልባ እግሬን፥ ዘይቴንና መጠጤን ከሚሰጡኝ ከውሽሞቼ በኋላ እሄዳለሁ ብላ አስነወረቻቸው።

verses.en: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ መንገድሽን በእሾህ እዘጋለሁ፥ መንገድዋንም እንዳታገኝ ቅጥርን እቀጥርባታለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my wine in the season thereof, and will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.
verses.am: ውሽሞችዋንም ትከተላለች፥ ነገር ግን አትደርስባቸውም፤ ትፈልጋቸውማለች፥ ነገር ግን አታገኛቸውም፤ እርስዋም። ከዛሬ ይልቅ የዚያን ጊዜ ይሻለኝ ነበርና ተመልሼ ወደ ቀደመው ባሌ እሄዳለሁ ትላለች።

verses.en: And now will I discover her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of mine hand.
verses.am: እርስዋም እህልንና ወይንን ጠጅ ዘይትንም የሰጠኋት፥ ለበኣልም የተሠራውን ብርና ወርቅ ያበዛሁላት እኔ እንደ ሆንሁ አላወቀችም።

verses.en: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.
verses.am: ስለዚህ እህሌን በጊዜዋ፥ ወይን ጠጄንም በወረትዋ እወስዳለሁ፥ ዕራቁትነትዋንም እንዳትሸፍን ጥጤንና የተልባ እግሬን እገፍፋታለሁ።

verses.en: And I will destroy her vines and her fig trees, whereof she hath said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.
verses.am: አሁንም ውሽሞችዋ እያዩ ነውርዋን እገልጣለሁ፤ ከእጄም ማንም አያድናትም።

verses.en: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, wherein she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her earrings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgat me, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: ደስታዋንም ሁሉ፥ በዓላቶችዋንም፥ መባቻዎችዋንም፥ ሰንበቶችዋንም፥ የተቀደሱትንም ጉባኤዎችን ሁሉ አስቀራለሁ።

verses.en: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably unto her.
verses.am: እርስዋም። ውሽሞቼ የሰጡኝ ዋጋዬ ይህ ነው ያለችውን ወይንዋንና በለስዋን አጠፋለሁ፤ ዱርም አደርገዋለሁ፥ የምድረ በዳም አራዊት ይበሉታል።

verses.en: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Mitsrayim.
verses.am: እኔን ረስታ ውሽሞችዋን እየተከተለች፥ በጕትቾችዋና በጌጥዋም እያጌጠች ለበኣሊም ያጠነችበትን ወራት እበቀልባታለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: And it shall be at that day, saith YAHUAH, that thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ አባብላታለሁ፥ ወደ ምድረ በዳም አመጣታለሁ፥ ለልብዋም እናገራለሁ።

verses.en: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.
verses.am: ከዚያም የወይን ቦታዋን፥ የተስፋ በርም እንዲሆንላት የአኮርን ሸለቆ እሰጣታለሁ፤ በዚያም ከግብጽ ምድር እንደ ወጣችበት ቀን እንደ ሕፃንነትዋ ወራት ትዘምራለች።

verses.en: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping things of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down safely.
verses.am: በዚያ ቀን ባሌ ብለሽ ትጠሪኛለሽ እንጂ ዳግመኛ በኣሌ ብለሽ አትጠሪኝም፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.en: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; yea, I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in lovingkindness, and in mercies.
verses.am: የበኣሊምን ስም ከአፍዋ አስወግደዋለሁና፥ በስማቸውም እንግዲህ አይታሰቡምና።

verses.en: I will even betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know YAHUAH.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ከምድር አራዊትና ከሰማይ ወፎች ከመሬትም ተንቀሳቃሾች ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደርግላቸዋለሁ፤ ቀስትንና ሰይፍን ሰልፍንም ከምድሩ እሰብራለሁ፥ ተከልለውም እንዲኖሩ አስተኛቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith YAHUAH, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;
verses.am: ለዘላለምም ለእኔ እንድትሆኚ አጭሻለሁ፤ በጽድቅና በፍርድ በምሕረትና በርኅራኄ አጭሻለሁ።

verses.en: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.
verses.am: ለእኔም እንድትሆኚ በመታመን አጭሻለሁ፤ አንቺም እግዚአብሔርን ታውቂአለሽ።

verses.en: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them which were not my people, Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art my YAHUAH.
verses.am: በዚያንም ቀን እመልሳለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤ ለሰማይ እመልሳለሁ፥ ሰማይም ለምድር ይመልሳል፤

verses.en: Then said YAHUAH unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of her friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of YAHUAH toward the children of Yisra'el, who look to other elohim, and love flagons of wine.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም። የእስራኤል ልጆች ወደ ሌሎች አማልክት ቢመለሱና የዘቢብ ጥፍጥፍን ቢወድዱ እንኳ፥ እግዚአብሔር እንደሚወድዳቸው አንተም ውሽማዋን የምትወድደውን አመንዝራይትን ሴት ውደድ አለኝ።

verses.en: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for an homer of barley, and an half homer of barley:
verses.am: እኔም በአሥራ አምስት ብርና በአንድ ቆሮስ መስፈሪያ ተኩል ገብስ ገዛኋት።

verses.en: And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for another man: so will I also be for thee.
verses.am: ከእኔ ጋር ብዙ ወራት ተቀመጪ፥ አታመንዝሪም፥ ለሌላ ሰውም አትሁኚ፤ እኔም እንዲሁ እሆንልሻለሁ አልኋት።

verses.en: For the children of Yisra'el shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim:
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ያለ ንጉሥና ያለ አለቃ፥ ያለ መሥዋዕትና ያለ ዓምድ፥ ያለ ኤፉድና ያለ ተራፊም ብዙ ወራት ይቀመጣሉና፤

verses.en: Afterward shall the children of Yisra'el return, and seek YAHUAH their YAHUAH, and Dawid their king; and shall fear YAHUAH and his goodness in the latter days.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ የእስራኤል ልጆች ተመልሰው አምላካቸውን እግዚአብሔርንና ንጉሣቸውን ዳዊትን ይፈልጋሉ፤ በኋለኛውም ዘመን ፈርተው ወደ እግዚአብሔርና ወደ በረከቱ ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: Hear the word of YAHUAH, ye children of Yisra'el: for YAHUAH hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of YAHUAH in the land.
verses.am: እናንተ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሆይ፥ እውነትና ምሕረት እግዚአብሔርንም ማወቅ በምድር ስለሌለ እግዚአብሔር በምድሩ ላይ ከሚኖሩ ጋር ክርክር አለውና የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ።

verses.en: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.
verses.am: እርግማንና ሐሰት ግዳይና ስርቆት ምንዝርናም ወጥተዋል፤ ደምም ወደ ደም ደርሶአል።

verses.en: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ምድሪቱ ታለቅሳለች፥ በእርስዋም የሚቀመጡ ሁሉ ከምድር አራዊትና ከሰማይ ወፎች ጋር ይደክማሉ፤ የባሕሩም ዓሦች ያልቃሉ።

verses.en: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሕዝብህ ከካህን ጋር እንደሚከራከሩ ናቸውና ማንም አይከራከር፥ ማንም አይዝለፍ።

verses.en: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.
verses.am: በቀንም ትሰናከላለህ፥ ነቢዩም ከአንተ ጋር በሌሊት ይሰናከላል፤ እናትህንም አጠፋታለሁ።

verses.en: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy YAHUAH, I will also forget thy children.
verses.am: ሕዝቤ እውቀት ከማጣቱ የተነሣ ጠፍቶአል፤ አንተም እውቀትን ጠልተሃልና እኔ ካህን እንዳትሆነኝ እጠላሃለሁ፤ የአምላክህንም ሕግ ረስተሃልና እኔ ደግሞ ልጆችህን እረሳለሁ።

verses.en: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.
verses.am: እንደ ብዛታቸው መጠን ኃጢአት ሠሩብኝ፤ እኔም ክብራቸውን ወደ ነውር እለውጣለሁ።

verses.en: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.
verses.am: የሕዝቤም ኃጢአት መብል ሆኖላቸዋል፥ ልባቸውንም ወደ በደላቸው አድርገዋል።

verses.en: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.
verses.am: እንደ ሕዝቡም እንዲሁ ካህኑ ይሆናል፤ በመንገዳቸውም እበቀላቸዋለሁ፥ ሥራቸውንም እመልስባቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to YAHUAH.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም መጠበቅ ትተዋልና ሲበሉ አይጠግቡም፥ ሲያመነዝሩም አይበዙም።

verses.en: Whoredom and wine and new wine take away the heart.
verses.am: ግልሙትናና የወይን ጠጅ ስካርም አእምሮን ያጠፋል።

verses.en: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused them to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their YAHUAH.
verses.am: የግልሙትና መንፈስ ሕዝቤን አስቶአቸዋልና፥ እነርሱም ከአምላካቸው ርቀው አመንዝረዋልና በትራቸውን ይጠይቃሉ፥ ዘንጋቸውም ይመልስላቸዋል።

verses.en: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof is good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.
verses.am: በተራሮችም ራስ ላይ ይሠዋሉ፤ ጥላውም መልካም ነውና ከኮምበልና ከልብን ከአሆማም ዛፍ በታች በኮረብቶች ላይ ያጥናሉ፤ ስለዚህ ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ ይገለሙታሉ፥ ሙሽሮቻችሁም ያመነዝራሉ።

verses.en: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall.
verses.am: ወንዶችም ደግሞ ከጋለሞቶች ጋር ይጫወታሉና፥ ከጋለሞቶችም ጋር ይሠዋሉና ሴቶች ልጆቻችሁ በገለሞቱ ጊዜ፥ ሙሽሮቻችሁም ባመነዘሩ ጊዜ አልቀጣቸውም፤ የማያስተውልም ሕዝብ ይገለበጣል።

verses.en: Though thou, Yisra'el, play the harlot, yet let not Yehudah offend; and come not ye unto Gilgal, neither go ye up to Bethaven, nor swear, YAHUAH liveth.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ አንተ ብታመነዝር ይሁዳ አይበድል፤ እናንተም ወደ ጌልገላ አትግቡ፥ ወደ ቤትአዌንም አትውጡ፥ ወይም። ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! ብላችሁ አትማሉ።

verses.en: For Yisra'el slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now YAHUAH will feed them as a lamb in a large place.
verses.am: እስራኤል እንደ እልከኛ ጊደር እንቢ ብሎአል፤ እግዚአብሔርስ በሰፊው ቦታ እንደ ጠቦት ያሰማራዋልን?

verses.en: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ከጣዖታት ጋር ተጋጠመ፤ ተወው።

verses.en: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers with shame do love, Give ye.
verses.am: ስካርን ፈጽመዋል፥ ግልሙትናንም አብዝተዋል፤ አለቆችዋም ነውርን እጅግ ወደዱ።

verses.en: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
verses.am: ነፋስ በክንፍዋ አስሮአታል፤ ከመሥዋዕታቸውም የተነሣ ያፍራሉ።

verses.en: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Yisra'el; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment is toward you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
verses.am: ካህናት ሆይ፥ ይህን ስሙ፤ የእስራኤል ቤት ሆይ፥ አድምጡ፤ የንጉሥ ቤት ሆይ፥ ልብ አድርጉ፤ በምጽጳ ላይ ወጥመድ፥ በታቦርም ላይ የተዘረጋ አሽክላ ሆናችኋልና ፍርድ በእናንተ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.
verses.am: ዓመፀኞችም እርድ አብዝተዋል፤ እኔ ግን እነዚያን ሁሉ እዘልፋለሁ።

verses.en: I know Ephraim, and Yisra'el is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou committest whoredom, and Yisra'el is defiled.
verses.am: ኤፍሬምን አውቀዋለሁ፥ እስራኤልም ከእኔ አልተሰወረም፤ ኤፍሬም ሆይ፥ ዛሬ አመንዝረሃል፥ እስራኤልም ረክሶአል።

verses.en: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their YAHUAH: for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they have not known YAHUAH.
verses.am: ወደ አምላካቸው ይመለሱ ዘንድ ሥራቸውን አላቀኑም፤ የግልሙትና መንፈስ በውስጣቸው አለና፤ እግዚአብሔርንም አላውቁምና።

verses.en: And the pride of Yisra'el doth testify to his face: therefore shall Yisra'el and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Yehudah also shall fall with them.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ትዕቢት በፊቱ ይመሰክራል፤ ስለዚህ እስራኤልና ኤፍሬም በኃጢአታቸው ይሰናከላሉ፤ ይሁዳም ደግሞ ከእነሱ ጋር ይሰናከላል።

verses.en: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek YAHUAH; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርንም ለመሻት በጎቻቸውንና ላሞቻቸውን ነድተው ይሄዳሉ፤ ነገር ግን እርሱ ከእነርሱም ተመልሶአልና አያገኙትም።

verses.en: They have dealt treacherously against YAHUAH: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
verses.am: ዲቃሎችን ልጆች ወልደዋልና እግዚአብሔርን ወንጅለዋል፤ አሁንም አንድ ወር እነርሱንና ርስታቸውን ይበላቸዋል።

verses.en: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Bethaven, after thee, O Benjamin.
verses.am: በጊብዓ መለከትን፥ በራማ እንቢልታን ንፉና። ብንያም ሆይ፥ ከአንተ በኋላ እያላችሁ በቤትአዌን ላይ እሪ በሉ።

verses.en: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Yisra'el have I made known that which shall surely be.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም በዘለፋ ቀን የፈረሰ ይሆናል። በእስራኤል ነገዶች ዘንድ በእርግጥ የሚሆነውን ነገር ገልጫለሁ።

verses.en: The princes of Yehudah were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
verses.am: የይሁዳ አለቆች ድምበርን እንደሚነቅሉ ሆነዋል፤ እኔም መዓቴን እንደ ውኃ አፈስስባቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ከትእዛዝ በኋላ መሄድን ወድዶአልና የተገፋና በፍርድ የተጐዳ ሆኖአል።

verses.en: Therefore will I be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Yehudah as rottenness.
verses.am: እኔም ለኤፍሬም እንደ ብል፥ ለይሁዳም ቤት እንደ ነቀዝ ሆኜአለሁ።

verses.en: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Yehudah saw his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.
verses.am: ኤፍሬምም ደዌውን፥ ይሁዳም ቍስሉን ባየ ጊዜ ኤፍሬም ወደ አሦር ሄደ ወደ ንጉሡም ወደ ኢያሪም መልእክተኛን ላከ፤ እርሱ ግን ይፈውሳችሁ ዘንድ፥ ከቊስላችሁም ያድናችሁ ዘንድ አልቻለም።

verses.en: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Yehudah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him.
verses.am: እኔም ለኤፍሬም እንደ አንበሳ፥ ለይሁዳም ቤት እንደ አንበሳ ደቦል እሆናለሁና፤ እኔም ነጥቄ እሄዳለሁ እወስድማለሁ፥ የሚያድንም አይገኝም።

verses.en: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.
verses.am: በደላቸውንም እስኪያውቁ ድረስ፥ ፊቴንም እስኪሹ ድረስ ሄጄ ወደ ስፍራዬ እመለሳለሁ፤ በመከራቸው ጊዜ እጅግ አድርገው ፊቴን ይፈልጋሉ።

verses.en: Come, and let us return unto YAHUAH: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
verses.am: ኑ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንመለስ፤ እርሱ ሰብሮናልና፥ እርሱም ይፈውሰናል፤ እርሱ መትቶናል፥ እርሱም ይጠግነናል።

verses.en: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.
verses.am: ከሁለት ቀን በኋላ ያድነናል፤ በሦስተኛውም ቀን ያስነሣናል፥ በፊቱም በሕይወት እንኖራለን።

verses.en: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know YAHUAH: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter and former rain unto the earth.
verses.am: እንወቅ፤ እናውቀውም ዘንድ እግዚአብሔርን እንከተል፤ እንደ ወገግታም ተዘጋጅቶ እናገኘዋለን፤ እንደ ዝናብም ምድርንም እንደሚያጠጣ እንደ መጨረሻ ዝናብ ይመጣል።

verses.en: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Yehudah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.
verses.am: ምሕረታችሁ እንደ ማለዳ ደመና፥ በማለዳም እንደሚያልፍ ጠል ነውና ኤፍሬም ሆይ፥ ምን ላድርግልህ? ይሁዳ ሆይ፥ ምን ላድርግልህ?

verses.en: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በነቢያት እጅ ቈረጥኋቸው፥ በአፌም ቃል ገደልኋቸው፤ ፍርዴም እንደ ብርሃን ይወጣል።

verses.en: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of YAHUAH more than burnt offerings.
verses.am: ከመሥዋዕት ይልቅ ምሕረትን፥ ከሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት ይልቅ እግዚአብሔርን ማወቅ እወድዳለሁና።

verses.en: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን እንደ አዳም ቃል ኪዳንን ተላልፈዋል፤ በዚያም ላይ ወንጅለውኛል።

verses.en: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.
verses.am: ገለዓድ ኃጢአትን የሚሠሩ ሰዎች ከተማ፥ በደምም የተቀባ ነው።

verses.en: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.
verses.am: ለሰውም እንደሚያደቡ ወንበዴዎች፥ እንዲሁ የካህናት ወገኖች በሴኬም መንገድ ላይ ይገድላሉ፤ ሴሰኝነትንም ያደርጋሉ።

verses.en: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Yisra'el: there is the whoredom of Ephraim, Yisra'el is defiled.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ቤት የሚያስፈራን ነገር አይቻለሁ፤ በዚያ በኤፍሬም ውስጥ ግልሙትና ተገኘ፥ እስራኤልም ረክሶአል።

verses.en: Also, O Yehudah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.
verses.am: ይሁዳ ሆይ፥ የሕዝቤን ምርኮ በምመልስበት ጊዜ ለአንተ ደግሞ መከር ተወስኖልሃል።

verses.en: When I would have healed Yisra'el, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in, and the troop of robbers spoileth without.
verses.am: በሐሰት አድርገዋልና፥ ሌባም ገብቶአልና፥ በውጭም ወንበዴዎች ቀምተዋልና እስራኤልን እፈውስ ዘንድ በወደድሁ ጊዜ የኤፍሬም ኃጢአትና የሰማርያ ክፋት ተገለጠ።

verses.en: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.
verses.am: እኔም ክፋታቸውን ሁሉ እንዳሰብሁ በልባቸው አያስቡም አሁንም ሥራቸው ከብባቸዋለች፥ በፊቴም አለች።

verses.en: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
verses.am: ንጉሡን በክፋታቸው፥ አለቆቹንም በሐሰታቸው ደስ አሰኝተዋል።

verses.en: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
verses.am: ሁሉም አመንዝራዎች ናቸው፤ ጋጋሪ እንደሚያነድድበት እንደ ምድጃ ናቸው፤ ሁሉ እስኪቦካ ድረስ እሳትን መቈስቈስና እርሾን መለወስ ይቆያል።

verses.en: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.
verses.am: በንጉሣችን ቀን አለቆች ከወይን ጠጅ ሙቀት የተነሣ ታመሙ፤ እርሱም ከዋዘኞች ጋር እጁን ዘረጋ።

verses.en: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.
verses.am: እያደቡ ልባቸውን እንደ ምድጃ አዘጋጅተዋል፤ አበዛቸውም ሌሊቱን ሁሉ አንቀላፋ፤ በጠባም ጊዜ እንደ እሳት ነበልባል ይነድዳል።

verses.en: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.
verses.am: ሁሉም እንደ ምድጃ ግለዋል፥ ፈራጆቻቸውንም በሉ፤ ነገሥታቶቻቸውም ሁሉ ወደቁ፤ ከእነርሱም ወደ እኔ የሚጮኽ የለም።

verses.en: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ከአሕዛብ ጋር ተደባለቀ፤ ኤፍሬም እንዳልተገላበጠ ቂጣ ነው።

verses.en: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.
verses.am: እንግዶች ጕልበቱን በሉት፥ እርሱም አላወቀም፤ ሽበትም ወጣበት፥ እርሱም አላወቀም።

verses.en: And the pride of Yisra'el testifieth to his face: and they do not return to YAHUAH their YAHUAH, nor seek him for all this.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ትዕቢቱ በፊቱ መሰከረ፤ ወደ አምላካቸው ወደ እግዚአብሔር ግን አልተመለሱም፥ በዚህም ሁሉ አልፈለጉትም።

verses.en: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Mitsrayim, they go to Assyria.
verses.am: ኤፍሬምም አእምሮ እንደሌላት እንደ ሰነፍ ርግብ ነው፤ ግብጽን ጠሩ፥ ወደ አሦርም ሄዱ።

verses.en: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.
verses.am: ሲሄዱ አሽክላዬን አዘረጋባቸዋለሁ፤ እንደ ሰማይ ወፎች አወርዳቸዋለሁ፤ መከራቸውን ሲሰሙ እገሥጻቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
verses.am: ከእኔ ፈቀቅ ብለዋልና ወዮላቸው! በእኔም ላይ ዐመፀዋልና ጥፋት ይምጣባቸው! እኔ ልታደጋቸው ወደድሁ፥ እነርሱ ግን በሐሰት ተናገሩብኝ።

verses.en: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.
verses.am: በመኝታቸው ላይ ሆነው ያለቅሱ ነበር እንጂ በልባቸው ወደ እኔ አልጮኹም፤ ስለ እህልና ስለ ወይን ጠጅ ይሰበሰቡ ነበር፤ በእኔም ላይ ዐመፁ።

verses.en: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.
verses.am: እኔም ክንዳቸውን አስተማርሁና አጸናሁ፤ እነርሱ ግን ክፉ ነገርን መከሩብኝ።

verses.en: They return, but not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Mitsrayim.
verses.am: ወደ ከንቱ ነገር ተመለሱ፤ እንደ ተንኰለኛ ቀስት ሆኑ፤ አለቆቻቸው ከምላሳቸው ቍጣ የተነሣ በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ፤ ይህ በግብጽ ምድር ውስጥ መሳለቂያ ይሆንባቸዋል።

verses.en: Set the trumpet to thy mouth. He shall come as an eagle against the house of YAHUAH, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.
verses.am: መለከትን ወደ አፍህ አቅርብ፤ ቃል ኪዳኔን ተላልፈዋልና፥ በሕጌም ላይ ዐምፀዋልና በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ላይ እንደ ንስር ይመጣል።

verses.en: Yisra'el shall cry unto me, My YAHUAH, we know thee.
verses.am: እነርሱም። አምላክ ሆይ፥ እኛ እስራኤል አወቅንህ ብለው ወደ እኔ ይጮኻሉ።

verses.en: Yisra'el hath cast off the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.
verses.am: እስራኤል ደግነትን ጥሎአል፤ ጠላትም ያሳድዱታል።

verses.en: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
verses.am: ለራሳቸው ነገሥታትን አነገሡ፥ ከእኔም ዘንድ አይደለም፤ አለቆችንም አደረጉ፥ እኔም አላወቅሁም፤ ለጥፋታቸውም ከብራቸውና ከወርቃቸው፤ ጣዖታትን ለራሳቸው አደረጉ።

verses.en: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast thee off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocency?
verses.am: ሰማርያ ሆይ፥ እምቦሳህን፤ ጥሎአል፤ ቍጣዬ በላያቸው ነድዶአል፤ እስከ መቼ ድረስ ንጹሕ ሊሆኑ አይችሉም?

verses.en: For from Yisra'el was it also: the workman made it; therefore it is not YAHUAH: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
verses.am: ይህ ደግሞ ከእስራኤል ዘንድ ነው፤ ሠራተኛ ሠራው፥ እርሱም አምላክ አይደለም፤ የሰማርያም እምቦሳ ይቈራረጣል።

verses.en: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
verses.am: ነፍስን ዘርተዋል፥ ዐውሎ ነፍስንም ያጭዳሉ፤ አገዳ የለውም፥ ከፍሬውም ዱቄት አይገኝም፤ ቢገኝም እንግዶች ይበሉታል።

verses.en: Yisra'el is swallowed up: now shall they be among the nations as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.
verses.am: እስራኤል ተውጦአል፥ በአሕዛብም መካከል ዛሬ እንደ ረከሰ ዕቃ ሆኖአል።

verses.en: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.
verses.am: ለብቻውም እንደሚቀመጥ እንደ ምድረ በዳ አህያ ወደ አሦር ወጥተዋል፤ ኤፍሬምም ወዳጆቹን በእጅ መንሻ ገዛ።

verses.en: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለአሕዛብ እጅ መንሻ ቢሰጡ እኔ አሁን እሰበስባቸዋለሁ፤ ከንጉሥና ከአለቆችም ሸክም የተነሣ ይደክማሉ።

verses.en: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ኃጢአትን ለመሥራት መሠዊያ አብዝቶአልና መሠዊያ ለኃጢአት ይሆንለታል።

verses.en: I have written to him the great things of my law, but they were counted as a strange thing.
verses.am: የሕጌን ብዛት ጽፌለታለሁ፤ እነርሱ ግን እንደ እንግዳ ነገር ቈጥረውታል።

verses.en: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat it; but YAHUAH accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Mitsrayim.
verses.am: መሥዋዕቴን ያቀርባሉ፥ ሥጋንም ያርዳሉ፥ ይበላሉም፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን አይቀበላቸውም፤ በደላቸውንም ያስባል፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይቀጣል፤ እነርሱም ወደ ግብጽ ይመለሳሉ።

verses.en: For Yisra'el hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Yehudah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
verses.am: እስራኤል ፈጣሪውን ረስቶአል፥ መስገጃዎችንም ሠርቶአል፤ ይሁዳም የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች አብዝቶአል፤ እኔ ግን በከተሞች ላይ እሳትን እሰድዳለሁ፥ አዳራሾችንም ትበላለች።

verses.en: Rejoice not, O Yisra'el, for joy, as other people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy YAHUAH, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ከአምላክህ ተለይተህ አመንዝረሃልና እንደ አሕዛብ ደስ አይበልህ፥ ሐሴትንም አታድርግ፤ በእህሉ አውድማ ሁሉ ላይ የግልሙትናን ዋጋ ወድደሃል።

verses.en: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.
verses.am: አውድማውና መጥመቂያው አይመግባቸውም፥ ጉሽ ጠጅም ይጐድልባታል።

verses.en: They shall not dwell in YAHUAH's land; but Ephraim shall return to Mitsrayim, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ምድር ላይ አይቀመጡም፤ ኤፍሬምም ወደ ግብጽ ይመለሳል፥ በአሦርም ርኩስን ነገር ይበላሉ።

verses.en: They shall not offer wine offerings to YAHUAH, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of YAHUAH.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም የወይን ጠጅን ቁርባን አያፈስሱም፥ መሥዋዕታቸውም ደስ አያሰኘውም፤ የኀዘንም እንጀራ ይሆንላቸዋል፥ የሚበላውም ሁሉ ይረክሳል፤ እንጀራቸውም ለሰውነታቸው ይሆናል እንጂ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት አይገባም።

verses.en: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of YAHUAH?
verses.am: በዓመት በዓል ቀንና በእግዚአብሔር በዓል ቀን ምን ታደርጋላችሁ?

verses.en: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Mitsrayim shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ከጥፋት ሸሽተው ሄዱ፥ ግብጽም ትሰበስባቸዋለች፥ ሜምፎስም ትቀብራቸዋለች፤ ሳማም የብራቸውን ጌጥ ይወርሳል፥ እሾህም በድንኳኖቻቸው ውስጥ ይበቅላል።

verses.en: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Yisra'el shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.
verses.am: የበቀል ወራት መጥቶአል፥ የፍዳም ወራት ደርሶአል፥ እስራኤልም ያውቃል፤ ከኃጢአትህና ከጠላትነትህ ብዛት የተነሣ ነቢዩ ሰንፎአል፥ መንፈስም ያለበት ሰው አብዶአል።

verses.en: The watchman of Ephraim was with my YAHUAH: but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and hatred in the house of his YAHUAH.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ከአምላኬ ጋር ተመልካች ነበረ፤ አሁን ግን ነቢዩ በመንገዱ ሁሉ ላይ የወፍ ወጥመድ ሆነ፥ በአምላኩም ቤት ጠላትነት አለ።

verses.en: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
verses.am: በጊብዓ ዘመን እንደ ነበረ እጅግ ረከሱ፤ እርሱም በደላቸውን ያስባል፥ ኃጢአታቸውንም ይበቀላል።

verses.en: I found Yisra'el like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: but they went to Baalpeor, and separated themselves unto that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.
verses.am: እስራኤልን በምድረ በዳ እንዳለ ወይን ሆኖ አገኘሁት፤ አባቶቻችሁንም ከመጀመሪያዋ ዓመት እንደ በለስ በkWraት ሆነው አየኋቸው፤ እነርሱ ግን ወደ ብዔልፌጎር መጡ፥ ለነውርም ተለዩ፥ እንደ ወደዱትም ርኩስ ሆኑ፥

verses.en: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
verses.am: የኤፍሬምም ክብር እንደ ወፍ በርሮ ይጠፋል፤ መውለድና መፅነስ ማርገዝም አይሆንላቸውም።

verses.en: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
verses.am: ልጆቻቸውንም ቢያሳድጉ ሰው እንዳይቀርላቸው ልጅ አልባ አደረጋቸዋለሁ፤ ከእነርሱም በራቅሁ ጊዜ ወዮላቸው!

verses.en: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
verses.am: እኔ እንዳየሁ የኤፍሬም ልጆች ለምርኮ ተሰጥተዋል፤ ኤፍሬምም ልጆቹን ወደ ገዳዩች ያወጣል።

verses.en: Give them, O YAHUAH: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
verses.am: አቤቱ፥ ስጣቸው፤ ምን ትሰጣቸዋለህ? የሚጨነግፍን ማኅፀን የደረቀውንም ጡት ስጣቸው።

verses.en: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.
verses.am: ክፋታቸው ሁሉ በጌልገላ አለ፤ በዚያ ጠልቻቸዋለሁ፤ ስለ ሠሩት ክፋት ከቤቴ አሳድዳቸዋለሁ፤ ከእንግዲህ ወዲያ አልወድዳቸውም፤ አለቆቻቸው ሁሉ ዓመፀኞች ናቸው።

verses.en: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ተመታ፥ ሥሩም ደረቀ፥ ፍሬም አያፈራም፤ ደግሞም ቢወልዱ የማኅፀናቸውን ፍሬ እገድላለሁ።

verses.en: My YAHUAH will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
verses.am: አልሰሙትምና አምላኬ ይጥላቸዋል፤ በአሕዛብም መካከል ተቅበዝባዦች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: Yisra'el is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.
verses.am: እስራኤል ፍሬው የበዛለት የለመለመ ወይን ነው፤ እንደ ፍሬው ብዛት መሠዊያውን አብዝቶአል፤ እንደ ምድሩም ማማር መጠን ሐውልቶችን እያሳመሩ ሠርተዋል።

verses.en: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
verses.am: ልባቸው ተከፈለ፤ አሁንም በደላቸውን ይሸከማሉ፤ እርሱ መሠዊያቸውን ያፈርሳል፥ ሐውልቶቻቸውን ያጠፋል።

verses.en: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not YAHUAH; what then should a king do to us?
verses.am: አሁንም። ንጉሥ የለንም፥ እግዚአብሔርን አልፈራንምና፤ ንጉሥስ ምን ያደርግልናል? ይላሉ።

verses.en: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
verses.am: የማይረባውን ቃል ይናገራሉ፤ ቃል ኪዳን በገቡ ጊዜ በሐሰት ይምላሉ፤ ስለዚህ መርዛም ሣር በእርሻ ትልም ላይ እንደሚበቅል መቅሠፍት ይበቅልባቸዋል።

verses.en: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Bethaven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof that rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
verses.am: የሰማርያ ሰዎች ስለ ቤትአዌን እምቦሳ ይፈራሉ፤ ክብሩም ከእርሱ ዘንድ ወጥቶአልና ሕዝቡ ያለቅሱለታል፥ የጣዖቱ ካህናትም በኀዘን ይንተባተባሉ።

verses.en: It shall be also carried unto Assyria for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Yisra'el shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
verses.am: ለንጉሡ ለኢያሪም እጅ መንሻ ይሆን ዘንድ ወደ አሦር ይማረካል፤ ኤፍሬምን እፍረት ይይዘዋል፥ እስራኤልም በምክሩ ያፍራል።

verses.en: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.
verses.am: ሰማርያ ከንጉሥዋ ጋር በውኃ ላይ እንዳለ አረፋ ጠፍታለች።

verses.en: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Yisra'el, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ኃጢአት የሆኑት የአዌን የኮረብታው መስገጃዎች ይፈርሳሉ፤ እሾህና አሜከላ በመሠዊያዎቻቸው ላይ ይበቅላል፤ ተራሮችንም። ክደኑን፥ ኮረብቶችንም። ውደቁብን ይሉአቸዋል።

verses.en: O Yisra'el, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ ከጊብዓ ዘመን ጀምረህ ኃጢአትን ሠርተሃል፤ በዚያ ጸንተዋል፤ በጊብዓ ላይ ሰልፍ አይደርስባቸውምን?

verses.en: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
verses.am: በፈቀድሁም ጊዜ እገሥጻቸዋለሁ፤ ስለ ሁለቱም ኃጢአታቸው በታሰሩ ጊዜ አሕዛብ ይሰበሰቡባቸዋል።

verses.en: And Ephraim is as an heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Yehudah shall plow, and Ya'aqob shall break his clods.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ማበራየት እንደ ለመደች ጊደር ነው፥ እኔ ግን በአንገቱ ውበት እጫንበታለሁ፤ በኤፍሬም ላይ እጠምድበታለሁ፥ ይሁዳም ያርሳል፥ ያዕቆብም አፈሩን ያለሰልሳል።

verses.en: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek YAHUAH, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር መጥቶ ጽድቅን እስኪያዘንብላችሁ ድረስ እርሱን የምትሹበት ዘመን ነውና ለእናንተ በጽድቅ ዝሩ፥ እንደ ምሕረቱም መጠን እጨዱ፥ ጥጋታችሁንም እረሱ።

verses.en: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
verses.am: ክፋትን አርሳችኋል፥ ኃጢአትንም አጭዳችኋል፥ የሐሰትንም ፍሬ በልታችኋል፤ በኃያላንህ ብዛት፥ በመንገድህም ላይ ታምነሃልና።

verses.en: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Betharbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
verses.am: በሕዝብህም መካከል ሽብር ይነሣል፤ እናትም ከልጆችዋ ጋር በተፈጠፈጠች ጊዜ ሰልማን ቤትአርብኤልን በሰልፍ ቀን እንዳፈረሰ፥ አምባዎችህ ሁሉ ይፈርሳሉ።

verses.en: So shall Bethel do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Yisra'el utterly be cut off.
verses.am: ከኃጢአታችሁም ክፋት የተነሣ ቤቴል እንዲሁ ያደርግባችኋል፤ በነጋ ጊዜ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ፈጽሞ ይጠፋል።

verses.en: When Yisra'el was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Mitsrayim.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሕፃን በነበረ ጊዜ ወደድሁት፥ ልጄንም ከግብጽ ጠራሁት።

verses.en: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
verses.am: አብዝቼ ብጠራቸው አጥብቀው ከፊቴ ራቁ፤ ለበኣሊምም ይሠዉ ነበር፥ ለተቀረጹ ምስሎችም ያጥኑ ነበር።

verses.en: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
verses.am: እኔም ኤፍሬምን ክንዱን ይዤ በእግሩ እንዲሄድ መራሁት፤ እኔም እፈውሳቸው እንደ ነበርሁ አላወቁም።

verses.en: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
verses.am: በሰው ገመድ በፍቅርም እስራት ሳብኋቸው፤ ለእነርሱም ቀምበርን ከጫንቃቸው ላይ እንደሚያነሣ ሆንሁ፥ ድርቆሽም ጣልሁላቸው።

verses.en: He shall not return into the land of Mitsrayim, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.
verses.am: ወደ እኔ ይመለሱ ዘንድ አልወደዱምና ወደ ግብጽ ምድር ይመለሳሉ፥ አሦርም ንጉሣቸው ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.
verses.am: ከመከሩትም ምክር የተነሣ ሰይፍ በከተሞቻቸው ላይ ይወድቃል፥ ከበርቴዎችንም ያጠፋል።

verses.en: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt him.
verses.am: ሕዝቤም ከእኔ ይመለሱ ዘንድ ወደዱ፤ ወደ ላይም ቢጠሩአቸው ማንም ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋቸው ዘንድ አይችልም።

verses.en: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Yisra'el? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ሆይ፥ እንዴት እጥልሃለሁ? እስራኤል ሆይ፥ እንዴትስ አሳልፌ እሰጥሃለሁ? እንዴትስ እንደ አዳማ እጥልሃለሁ? እንዴትስ እንደ ሲባዮ አደርግሃለሁ? ልቤ በውስጤ ተናውጣለች፥ ምሕረቴም ተነሣሥታለች።

verses.en: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am YAHUAH, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city.
verses.am: እኔ አምላክ ነኝ እንጂ ሰው አይደለሁምና፥ በመካከልህም ቅዱሱ ነኝና የቁጣዬን መቅሠፍት አላደርግም፥ ኤፍሬምንም አጠፋ ዘንድ አልመለስም፤ በመዓትም አልመጣም።

verses.en: They shall walk after YAHUAH: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን ይከተላሉ፥ እርሱም እንደ አንበሳ ያገሣል፤ ባገሣም ጊዜ ልጆች እየተንቀጠቀጡ ከምዕራብ ይመጣሉ።

verses.en: They shall tremble as a bird out of Mitsrayim, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith YAHUAH.
verses.am: እንደ ወፍም ከግብጽ፥ እንደ ርግብም ከአሦር ምድር እየተንቀጠቀጡ ይመጣሉ፤ በቤታቸውም አኖራቸዋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር።

verses.en: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Yisra'el with deceit: but Yehudah yet ruleth with YAHUAH, and is faithful with the saints.
Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Mitsrayim.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም በሐሰት፥ የእስራኤልም ቤት በተንኰል ከበበኝ፤ ይሁዳም ከታመነው ቅዱሱ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር አይጸናም።

verses.en: YAHUAH hath also a controversy with Yehudah, and will punish Ya'aqob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም ነፋስን ይበላል፥ የምሥራቅንም ነፋስ ይከተላል፤ ሁልጊዜም ሐሰትንና ተንኰልን ያበዛል፤ ከአሦር ጋር ቃል ኪዳን ያደርጋሉ፥ ወደ ግብጽም ዘይት ይወስዳሉ።

verses.en: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with YAHUAH:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ደግሞ ከይሁዳ ጋር ክርክር አለው፥ ያዕቆብንም እንደ መንገዱ ይቀጣል፤ እንደ ሥራውም ይመልስለታል።

verses.en: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him in Bethel, and there he spake with us;
verses.am: በማኅፀን ውስጥ ወንድሙን በተረከዙ ያዘው፥ በጕልማስነቱም ጊዜ ከአምላክ ጋር ታገለ፤

verses.en: Even YAHUAH of hosts; YAHUAH is his memorial.
verses.am: ከመልአኩም ጋር ታግሎ አሸነፈ፤ አልቅሶም ለመነው። በቤቴልም አገኘው፥ በዚያም ከእኛ ጋር ተነጋገረ።

verses.en: Therefore turn thou to thy YAHUAH: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy YAHUAH continually.
verses.am: እርሱም የሠራዊት አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ የመታሰቢያው ስም እግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ወደ አምላክህ ተመለስ፤ ምሕረትንና ፍርድን ጠብቅ፥ ዘወትርም በአምላክህ ታመን።

verses.en: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.
verses.am: ከከነዓን ወገን ነው፤ በእጁ የተንኰል ሚዛን አለ፥ ሽንገላንም ይወድዳል።

verses.en: And I that am YAHUAH thy YAHUAH from the land of Mitsrayim will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.
verses.am: ኤፍሬምም። ባለ ጠጋ ሆኜአለሁ፥ ሀብትንም አግኝቻለሁ፥ በድካሜም ሁሉ ኃጢአት የሚሆን በደል አይገኝብኝም አለ።

verses.en: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.
verses.am: እኔም ከግብጽ ጀምሬ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ እንደ ዓመት በዓል ቀን እንደ ገና በድንኳን እንድትኖር አደርግሃለሁ።

verses.en: Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
verses.am: ለነቢያትም ተናግሬአለሁ፥ ራእይንም አብዝቻለሁ፤ በነቢያትም እጅ ምሳሌዎችን አውጥቻለሁ።

verses.en: And Ya'aqob fled into the country of Syria, and Yisra'el served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.
verses.am: ኃጢአት በገለዓድ አለ፤ ፈጽመው ከንቱ ናቸው፤ ወይፈኖች በጌልገላ ይሠዋሉ፥ መሠዊያዎቻቸውም በእርሻ ትልም ላይ የድንጋይ ክምር ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And by a prophet YAHUAH brought Yisra'el out of Mitsrayim, and by a prophet was he preserved.
verses.am: ያዕቆብ ወደ ሶርያ አገር ሸሸ፥ እስራኤልም ስለ ሚስት አገለገለ፥ ስለ ሚስትም ጠባቂ ነበረ።

verses.en: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his YAHUAH return unto him.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በነቢይ እጅ እስራኤልን ከግብጽ አወጣ፥ በነቢይም እጅ ጠበቀው።

verses.en: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Yisra'el; but when he offended in Baal, he died.
verses.am: ኤፍሬም በተናገረ ጊዜ ፍርሃት ነበረ፥ በእስራኤልም ዘንድ ታበየ፤ ነገር ግን በኣልን በማምለክ በበደለ ጊዜ ሞተ።

verses.en: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.
verses.am: አሁንም ኃጢአትን ይሠሩ ዘንድ ጨመሩ፤ በብራቸውም ለራሳቸው ቀልጦ የተሠራ ምስልን፥ እንደ ጥበባቸውም ጣዖታትን ሠርተዋል፤ ሁሉም የሠራተኛ ሥራ ናቸው። ስለ እነርሱም። የሚሠዉ ሰዎች እምቦሳውን ይሳሙ ይላሉ።

verses.en: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.
verses.am: ስለዚህም እንደ ማለዳ ደመና፥ በጥዋትም እንደሚያልፍ ጠል፥ በዐውሎ ነፍስም ከአውድማ እንደሚበተን እብቅ፥ ከመስኮትም እንደሚወጣ ጢስ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: Yet I am YAHUAH thy YAHUAH from the land of Mitsrayim, and thou shalt know no god but me: for there is no saviour beside me.
verses.am: እኔ ግን ከግብጽ ምድር ጀምሬ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ አምላክ አታውቅም፥ ከእኔም በቀር ሌላ መድኃኒት የለም።

verses.en: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
verses.am: በምድረ በዳ፥ እጅግ በደረቀ ምድር አውቄህ ነበር።

verses.en: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.
verses.am: ከተሰማሩ በኋላ ጠገቡ፥ በጠገቡም ጊዜ ልባቸው ታበየ፤ ስለዚህ ረሱኝ።

verses.en: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them:
verses.am: ስለዚህም እኔ እንደ አንበሳ ሆንሁባቸው፥ እንደ ነብርም በመንገድ አጠገብ አደባባቸዋለሁ፤

verses.en: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.
verses.am: ልጅዋ እንደ ተነጠቀባት ድብ እገጥማቸዋለሁ፥ የልባቸውንም ስብ እቀድዳለሁ፤ በዚያም እንደ አንበሳ እበላቸዋለሁ፥ የምድረ በዳም አውሬ ይነጣጠቃቸዋል።

verses.en: O Yisra'el, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me is thine help.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ በእኔ በረዳትህ ላይ በመነሣትህ ጥፋትህ ነው።

verses.en: I will be thy king: where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?
verses.am: በየከተማህ ሁሉ ያድንህ ዘንድ ንጉሥህ ወዴት አለ? ስለ እነርሱም። ንጉሥንና አለቆችን ስጠኝ ብለህ የተናገርኸው መሳፍንቶችህ ወዴት አሉ?

verses.en: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took him away in my wrath.
verses.am: በቍጣዬ ንጉሥን ሰጠሁህ፥ በመዓቴም ሻርሁት።

verses.en: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.
verses.am: የኤፍሬም በደል ታስሮአል፥ ኃጢአቱም ተከማችቶአል።

verses.en: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.
verses.am: ምጥ እንደ ያዛት ሴት ጭንቅ ይመጣበታል፤ በሚወለድበት ጊዜ በማኅፀን አፍ ቀጥ ብሎ አይወጣምና አእምሮ የሌለው ልጅ ነው።

verses.en: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues; O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
verses.am: ከሲኦል እጅ እታደጋቸዋለሁ፥ ከሞትም እቤዣቸዋለሁ፤ ሞት ሆይ፥ ቸነፈርህ ወዴት አለ? ሲኦል ሆይ፥ ማጥፋትህ ወዴት አለ? ርኅራኄ ከዓይኔ ተሰወረች።

verses.en: Though he be fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of YAHUAH shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.
verses.am: በወንድሞቹ መካከል ፍሬያማ ቢሆን የምሥራቅ ነፋስ ይመጣል፥ የእግዚአብሔር ነፋስ ከምድረ በዳ ይመጣል፤ ምንጩንም ያደርቃል፥ ፈሳሹንም ያጠፋል፥ የተከበሩ ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ያሉበትን መዝገብ ይበዘብዛል።

verses.en: Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her YAHUAH: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
verses.am: ሰማርያ በአምላክዋ ላይ ዐምፃለችና በደልዋን ትሸከማለች፤ በሰይፍ ይወድቃሉ፥ ሕፃኖቻቸውም ይፈጠፈጣሉ፥ እርጕዞቻቸውም ይቀደዳሉ።

verses.en: O Yisra'el, return unto YAHUAH thy YAHUAH; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
verses.am: እስራኤል ሆይ፥ በኃጢአትህ ወድቀሃልና ወደ አምላክህ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ተመለስ።

verses.en: Take with you words, and turn to YAHUAH: say unto him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.
verses.am: ከእናንተ ጋር ቃልን ውሰዱ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ተመልሳችሁ። ኃጢአትን ሁሉ አስወግድ፥ በቸርነትም ተቀበለን፥ በወይፈንም ፋንታ የከንፈራችንን ፍሬ እንሰጣለን።

verses.en: Asshur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our elohim: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
verses.am: አሦር አያድነንም፤ በፈረስ ላይ አንቀመጥም፤ ድሀ አደጉም በአንተ ዘንድ ምሕረትን ያገኛልና ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ ለእጆቻችን ሥራ። አምላኮቻችን ናችሁ አንላቸውም በሉት።

verses.en: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for mine anger is turned away from him.
verses.am: ቍጣዬ ከእርሱ ዘንድ ተመልሶአልና ዓመፃቸውን እፈውሳለሁ፥ በገዛ ፈቃዴ እወድዳቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: I will be as the dew unto Yisra'el: he shall grow as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም እንደ ጠል እሆነዋለሁ፤ እንደ አበባም ያብባል፥ እንደ ሊባኖስም ሥሩን ይሰድዳል።

verses.en: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
verses.am: ቅርንጫፎቹም ይዘረጋሉ፥ ውበቱም እንደ ወይራ፥ ሽታውም እንደ ሊባኖስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: They that dwell under his shadow shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
verses.am: ከጥላውም በታች የሚቀመጡ ይመለሳሉ፤ ከእህሉም የተነሣ ይጠግባሉ፤ እንደ ወይንም አረግ ያብባሉ፤ መታሰቢያውም እንደ ሊባኖስ ወይን ጠጅ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir tree. From me is thy fruit found.
verses.am: ከእንግዲህ ወዲያ ጣዖት ለኤፍሬም ምንድር ነው? እኔ ሰምቼዋለሁ፥ ወደ እርሱም እመለከታለሁ፤ እኔ እንደ ለመለመ ጥድ ነኝ፤ ፍሬህ በእኔ ዘንድ ይገኛል።

verses.en: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of YAHUAH are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall therein.
verses.am: ይህን ነገር የሚያስተውል ጠቢብ፥ የሚያውቃትም አስተዋይ ማን ነው? የእግዚአብሔር መንገድ ቅን ነው፥ ጻድቃንም ይሄዱበታል፤ ተላላፊዎች ግን ይወድቁበታል።
